root_cause: The cumulative clock integrated the entire PF timestep and emitted multiple first passages even though the first K-hit completion immediately unblocked the domain. The release caller applied one state transition, leaving later same-step hits in the primitive ledger after the applicable blocked state had ended.
corrections: CumulativeHazardClock can stop exactly at a caller-declared maximum passage count without integrating the inapplicable timestep remainder.
MultiHitProcess can stop at the first completion, including when K-1 hits were accumulated before the call.
Blocked GB, TJ, nonserial climb, and EntityPin releases use stop-at-completion semantics.
Unblocked explicit-mode flux retains all same-step passages.
Packet-reset window age advances only to the physical completion time.
policy: All partial checkpoints, event ledgers, and trajectories remain in place. They are excluded from final inference, and the full 165-run matrix is relaunched from the corrected tested SHA.
